meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给画面加上推拉、缩放与运镜关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在视频合成里做镜头运动或关键帧动画。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-ins, zooms, and camera-move keyframes to a composition
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need camera moves or keyframe animation inside video compositions.

howto.what: 它会为 HyperFrames 画面编写 seek-safe 关键帧——推近拉远、缩放、重新取景、Ken Burns 平移、裁剪/遮罩、SVG 描边变形、3D 深度等,再用 lint、check、keyframes 与抽帧截图验证画面。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推近、缩放、重新取景或 Ken Burns 等镜头关键帧时接管;它不负责整体场景策略、品牌设计、素材选取或视频规划。

say.text: 给这个镜头加一段从 1 倍推到 1.4 倍的推近关键帧
say.note: 会生成 seek-safe 的 scale 关键帧并抽帧验证

say.text: 把这个片段改成 Ken Burns 平移,主体不要变形
say.note: 动画 wrapper 的位移加缩放,几何由你指定

say.text: 用 stroke draw 做出标题描边生长的效果

howto.what_en: It writes seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames shots — punch-ins, zooms, Ken Burns pans, crop/mask reframes, SVG draw/morph, 3D depth — then verifies the pixels with lint, check, keyframes, and shot snapshots.
howto.when_en: Takes over when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in, zoom, reframe or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes. It does not cover scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, or video planning.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in keyframe pushing this shot from 1x to 1.4x
say_en.note: Builds seek-safe scale keyframes and snapshots them

say_en.text: Turn this clip into a Ken Burns pan that keeps the subject intact
say_en.note: Animates a wrapper's translation plus scale

say_en.text: Use stroke draw to grow the title outline
say_en.note: Prefers DrawSVGPlugin, falls back to dasharray
